taproot_settings.title: Settings
taproot_settings.description: The parts of taproot.yaml you can change here. Each section applies at once and is written to taproot.yaml after the server accepts it.

retention.title: Request logs
retention.description: Each proxied request and its reply, for the Request Logs page.
retention.record_off: Recording is off. Taproot still stores requests that return an error (status 400 or above). The limits below still apply to the logs already stored.
retention.record_failed: The limits were saved, but the recording switch was not: {{message}}
retention.record_unknown: Taproot could not read config.yaml, so the recording switch is unavailable. Reload the page to try again.
retention.limits_hint: When a limit is reached, the oldest logs are deleted first. Changes apply at the next pruning pass.
retention.exclude_hint: One per line: a path, or a method and a path. * matches within a path segment.
retention.keep_404: Record 404s for routes the proxy does not serve

backups.title: Backup schedule
backups.description: A daily snapshot of config, credentials, and the database.
backups.keep_hint: The count applies to each kind separately: scheduled, manual, and pre-restore backups each keep this many. Lowering it removes the oldest of each kind after the next backup is written.

ingest.title: Quota polling
ingest.description: How often taproot asks Anthropic and OpenAI for the quota of accounts that have had no traffic.
ingest.label: Poll every
ingest.hint: A Go duration such as 15m or 1h30m; 0 stops polling. Takes effect after a restart.
ingest.restart_required: Saved as {{saved}}. Taproot polls every {{active}} until it restarts.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Posts to a Discord channel when an account hits a quota limit, a provider's accounts are all out, a login stops working, or a Claude reset grant with resets left expires within a day.
alerts.webhook_invalid: The webhook in taproot.yaml is not a Discord webhook URL, so alerts are off. Paste a new webhook below, or remove it.
alerts.webhook_hint: In Discord, open the channel's settings, then Integrations, Webhooks, and Copy Webhook URL. The URL is a secret: taproot stores it in taproot.yaml and never shows it again.

errors.days_range: Days must be a whole number from 1 to 3650.
errors.size_format: Write the size as a number and unit, such as 20 GB or 512 MB.
errors.size_min: The size limit must be at least 1 MB.
errors.exclude_format: {{detail}} must be a path starting with /, optionally after a method.
errors.keep_range: Keep must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
errors.time_format: Use a 24-hour time such as 00:00 or 14:30.
errors.duration_format: Use a duration such as 15m or 1h30m, or 0.
errors.webhook_format: Paste a Discord webhook URL, which starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
